text: {"label": "Food and Liquid Delivery and Intake","definition": "Work on how food and liquids are delivered and consumed, including clinical feeding services, liquid expulsion, and drinking, as well as feeders, dispensers, and food reinforcers for nonhuman animals such as horses and guinea pigs.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on drinking, liquid intake, feeding service delivery, and food-dispensing for diverse species, not food selectivity or schedule effects, shock or drug-delivery apparatus, or pigeon key-peck research."}
